Prototype 5 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (62%), with EOG (34%) and EMG (4%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+3.1 dB, sensitivity=3.8) and suppressed β_h (-0.6 dB, sensitivity=3.4).
The δ activity is present in 45% of each epoch (intermittent), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 24% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
